content.short: Royco splits yield sources into senior and junior tranches with differing risk and return.
content.description: Royco splits any yield source into senior, junior and senior LP tranches, so participants choose where they sit in the loss waterfall. Its interface compares trailing rates, remaining capacity and downside protection across curator-operated vaults. Tranching is standard practice in structured credit and translates cleanly on-chain, where the waterfall can be enforced by contract instead of by documentation. Its risk framework, governance and fee schedule sit alongside the vault products.
content.meta: Senior, junior and LP tranches, so participants choose where they sit in the loss waterfall.
